capabilities: Compile ordered scene notes into a screenplay
Configure project structure from a YAML master note
Export a PDF with title page and XMP metadata
extras: Early release; author advises reviewing exported PDFs before production or distribution. PDF export is desktop-only (compile and preview work on mobile). Full documentation lives in linked pages outside the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown scene notes into properly formatted screenplay pages with title pages, page breaks, and PDF metadata.
summary: Screenplay compiler that assembles scene notes into industry-standard Fountain-formatted pages and exports a metadata-rich PDF from a YAML master note.
